item.title: BOK counting on mortgage finance for a boost in 2026
item.description: The Tulsa, Oklahoma-based bank expects the pace of loan growth to quicken this year, driven in part by its nine-month-old warehouse lending business.

item.title: Former Citi exec alleges sexual harassment by wealth chief
item.description: Julia Carreon is suing the bank, alleging she suffered race and sex discrimination, including sexual harassment by Andy Sieg, the bank's head of wealth management. On Tuesday, Citi hit back by filing a petition to compel arbitration and accusing Carreon of making false claims.

item.title: Fed likely to keep rates steady as economy shows mixed signals
item.description: As the Federal Open Market Committee announces its near-term interest rate plans Wednesday, market watchers expect the central bank to hold interest rates steady as policymakers seek greater clarity on the health of the economy.

item.title: What bank leaders can learn from an unlikely college football champion
item.description: There are qualities in people and organizations that experts, trying to predict future performance, routinely miss. That includes internal alignment of team members around a strong corporate culture.

item.title: U.S. Bancorp CEO Kedia will add board chair title in April
item.description: The Minneapolis-based company will return to its former governance structure when it installs CEO Gunjan Kedia as board chair. Andy Cecere had served as chair during his tenure as the company's chief executive, and then became executive chair when he stepped down as CEO last year.

item.title: Amazon changes course on its checkout-free tech
item.description: The e-commerce giant, which is in the midst of a corporate downsizing, is discontinuing its Go and Fresh stores and One palm checkout while it repurposes the underlying technology.

item.title: Revolut drops anchor in Mexico, JPMorganChase hires a payments chief
item.description: The London-based fintech has launched a suite of financial services as its global expansion gains steam. That and more in the American Banker global payments and fintech roundup.

item.title: Bankers at Bankwell meetup share hopes for, advice on AI
item.description: The Connecticut bank invited rival bankers, lawyers and regulators to share their experiences with and warnings on using AI.

item.title: Fed holds rates steady; Powell cites easing economic risks
item.description: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell said recent data suggests less tension between the employment and inflation sides of the central bank's dual mandate, reducing the need for an immediate policy change.

item.title: Prosperity to acquire rival Houston bank in $2 billion deal
item.description: Acquiring Stellar Bancorp will create the second-largest Texas-headquartered bank, with a No. 5 deposit share in the massive Houston marketplace.
